title: ChatGPT '80s trend: Prompts to try it yourself
excerpt: Big hair, faded denim and a Friday night at the roller rink: Your next throwback photo doesn’t have to come from an old family album.

Big hair, faded denim and a Friday night at the roller rink: Your next throwback photo doesn’t have to come from an old family album.

 

By

Olivia Tauber

Olivia Tauber

Deputy Digital Culture Editor

Olivia Tauber is the deputy editor of digital culture, covering creators, media, movies, beauty, and more. Based in New York, her work has appeared in The New York Times, Vanity Fair, The Cut, Teen Vogue, Complex, and Interview Magazine. She holds a Master's degree in Journalism from NYU and a Bachelor's from the University of Michigan. She also runs Fan Mail, a weekly pop-culture newsletter.

on September 9, 2026

Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on Flipboard

Ever wonder what your camera roll would look like in 1985? There’s a ChatGPT prompt for that.

The AI tool’s latest trend has social media users turning current pictures into imagined throwbacks, complete with vintage outfits, big hair and that slightly faded family-album finish.

This Tweet is currently unavailable. It might be loading or has been removed.

Want to see yourself posing for a mall portrait, heading to an arcade date or hanging out with friends at the roller rink? Start a new ChatGPT conversation and attach a clear, well-lit photo of yourself or the people you want pictured. Then describe the setting, clothes, hairstyle and lighting you have in mind.

Don’t forget to tell it what to keep: your recognizable face, natural skin tone, age and facial structure. You’re asking for an ’80s wardrobe, after all — you still want to look like yourself.

Not sure where to start? See below for a list of prompts to try or customize. Swap in the clothes and locations you’d actually want in your photo. Thank us later.

For a classic 1985 makeover

This Tweet is currently unavailable. It might be loading or has been removed.

"Using my uploaded photo, imagine me in an American snapshot taken in 1985. Preserve my recognizable identity, facial features, natural skin tone and current age. Give me a distinctly mid-1980s hairstyle suited to my hair texture, an oversized patterned shirt, high-waisted jeans and period-appropriate accessories. Place me outside a neighborhood record store with a window display of vinyl records. Use direct camera flash, subtle analog grain, slightly faded colors and soft photographic detail. Add a small red-orange date stamp reading ‘09 09 85’ in the lower corner. Avoid modern objects and any other added text.”

For a group photo

"Use the uploaded reference photo to recreate our group hanging out in an American suburban living room in 1988. Preserve each person’s individual facial features, age and natural skin tone. Give us distinct casual outfits with denim, patterned sweaters and colorful shirts. Include a wood-paneled wall, a patterned sofa, a cassette player and a boxy television. Arrange us naturally, as though a friend has just taken a quick flash photo."

Mashable Trend Report

For a solo studio portrait

This Tweet is currently unavailable. It might be loading or has been removed.

"Use my uploaded photo to create a realistic portrait of me at an American shopping-mall photography studio in 1986. Preserve my recognizable facial features, natural skin tone, age and facial structure. Give me a denim jacket over a simple T-shirt and a softly feathered hairstyle suited to my hair texture. Use a mottled blue studio backdrop, soft portrait lighting and subtle film grain. The finished image should feel like a print from a family album.”

For a road-trip photo

This Tweet is currently unavailable. It might be loading or has been removed.

"Create a realistic photograph of me standing beside a parked 1980s American coupe at a roadside stop in 1987. Use my uploaded photo to preserve my recognizable face, age and natural skin tone. Give me straight-leg jeans, a tucked-in T-shirt, a lightweight windbreaker and sunglasses resting on my head. Use late-afternoon sunlight and the slightly faded colors of a printed vacation photo. Keep visible cars, signs and accessories appropriate to the year."

For a couple

This Tweet is currently unavailable. It might be loading or has been removed.

"Using our uploaded photo as the reference, create a candid picture of us on a date at an American arcade in 1985. Preserve both people’s recognizable faces, natural skin tones, ages and facial structures. Dress us in casual denim, colorful tops and period-appropriate sneakers. Include arcade cabinets, softly glowing screens and a direct camera-flash effect. Keep our poses relaxed and our skin texture realistic."

For a roller-rink night

This Tweet is currently unavailable. It might be loading or has been removed.

"Transform my uploaded photo into a realistic snapshot of me at an American roller rink in 1984. Keep my identity, age, facial structure and natural skin tone consistent with the reference. Dress me in a colorful athletic top, high-waisted shorts, striped socks and quad roller skates. Place me beside the rink railing with colored lights and skaters in the background. Use subtle motion blur behind me and the look of a flash photograph."

If the first result needs work

Love the outfit, but the face looks a little off? Tell ChatGPT exactly what needs fixing. For example: "Bring my face closer to the original reference. Keep my original face shape, eyes, nose and smile. Leave the outfit and background as they are."

If it went a little too big on the hair and clothes, try: "Make the clothing and hair more understated, like an ordinary weekend snapshot from 1985."

Once you get a version you like, you can keep the look and change the location. OpenAI recommends making small, targeted revisions and spelling out what should stay the same.

Of course, this isn’t ChatGPT’s first social media makeover. We’ve seen the caricature trend turn users into cartoon versions of themselves, and the "make it more" trend had people repeatedly asking ChatGPT to exaggerate images until things got ridiculous. This time, the assignment is a little more nostalgic.

Before you post, check faces, hands and background details against your original photo. Some participants in a Reddit discussion of the trend have complained that the results don’t really look like them, so take a second look! Then comes the real decision: whether to leave that hairstyle in 1985 or bring it to your next salon appointment.

Big hair, faded denim and a Friday night at the roller rink: Your next throwback photo doesn’t have to come from an old family album.

 

By

奥利维亚·陶伯

奥利维亚·陶伯

数字文化副编辑

Olivia Tauber 是《数字文化》副主编，内容涵盖创作者、媒体、电影、美妆等。 她居住在纽约，作品曾出现在《纽约时报》、《名利场》、《The Cut》、《Teen Vogue》、《Complex》和《Interview》杂志上。 她拥有纽约大学新闻学硕士学位和密歇根大学学士学位。 她还经营《粉丝邮报》（Fan Mail），这是一份每周流行文化时事通讯。

Ever wonder what your camera roll would look like in 1985? There’s a ChatGPT prompt for that.

The AI tool’s latest trend has social media users turning current pictures into imagined throwbacks, complete with vintage outfits, big hair and that slightly faded family-album finish.

Want to see yourself posing for a mall portrait, heading to an arcade date or hanging out with friends at the roller rink? Start a new ChatGPT conversation and attach a clear, well-lit photo of yourself or the people you want pictured. Then describe the setting, clothes, hairstyle and lighting you have in mind.

Don’t forget to tell it what to keep: your recognizable face, natural skin tone, age and facial structure. You’re asking for an ’80s wardrobe, after all — you still want to look like yourself.

Not sure where to start? See below for a list of prompts to try or customize. Swap in the clothes and locations you’d actually want in your photo. Thank us later.

For a classic 1985 makeover

此推文当前不可用。 它可能正在加载或已被删除。

"Using my uploaded photo, imagine me in an American snapshot taken in 1985. Preserve my recognizable identity, facial features, natural skin tone and current age. Give me a distinctly mid-1980s hairstyle suited to my hair texture, an oversized patterned shirt, high-waisted jeans and period-appropriate accessories. Place me outside a neighborhood record store with a window display of vinyl records. Use direct camera flash, subtle analog grain, slightly faded colors and soft photographic detail. Add a small red-orange date stamp reading ‘09 09 85’ in the lower corner. Avoid modern objects and any other added text.”

For a group photo

"Use the uploaded reference photo to recreate our group hanging out in an American suburban living room in 1988. Preserve each person’s individual facial features, age and natural skin tone. Give us distinct casual outfits with denim, patterned sweaters and colorful shirts. Include a wood-paneled wall, a patterned sofa, a cassette player and a boxy television. Arrange us naturally, as though a friend has just taken a quick flash photo."

For a solo studio portrait

此推文当前不可用。 它可能正在加载或已被删除。

"Use my uploaded photo to create a realistic portrait of me at an American shopping-mall photography studio in 1986. Preserve my recognizable facial features, natural skin tone, age and facial structure. Give me a denim jacket over a simple T-shirt and a softly feathered hairstyle suited to my hair texture. Use a mottled blue studio backdrop, soft portrait lighting and subtle film grain. The finished image should feel like a print from a family album.”

For a road-trip photo

此推文当前不可用。 它可能正在加载或已被删除。

"Create a realistic photograph of me standing beside a parked 1980s American coupe at a roadside stop in 1987. Use my uploaded photo to preserve my recognizable face, age and natural skin tone. Give me straight-leg jeans, a tucked-in T-shirt, a lightweight windbreaker and sunglasses resting on my head. Use late-afternoon sunlight and the slightly faded colors of a printed vacation photo. Keep visible cars, signs and accessories appropriate to the year."

For a couple

"Using our uploaded photo as the reference, create a candid picture of us on a date at an American arcade in 1985. Preserve both people’s recognizable faces, natural skin tones, ages and facial structures. Dress us in casual denim, colorful tops and period-appropriate sneakers. Include arcade cabinets, softly glowing screens and a direct camera-flash effect. Keep our poses relaxed and our skin texture realistic."

For a roller-rink night

此推文当前不可用。 它可能正在加载或已被删除。

"Transform my uploaded photo into a realistic snapshot of me at an American roller rink in 1984. Keep my identity, age, facial structure and natural skin tone consistent with the reference. Dress me in a colorful athletic top, high-waisted shorts, striped socks and quad roller skates. Place me beside the rink railing with colored lights and skaters in the background. Use subtle motion blur behind me and the look of a flash photograph."

If the first result needs work

Love the outfit, but the face looks a little off? Tell ChatGPT exactly what needs fixing. For example: "Bring my face closer to the original reference. Keep my original face shape, eyes, nose and smile. Leave the outfit and background as they are."

If it went a little too big on the hair and clothes, try: "Make the clothing and hair more understated, like an ordinary weekend snapshot from 1985."

Once you get a version you like, you can keep the look and change the location. OpenAI recommends making small, targeted revisions and spelling out what should stay the same.

Of course, this isn’t ChatGPT’s first social media makeover. We’ve seen the caricature trend turn users into cartoon versions of themselves, and the "make it more" trend had people repeatedly asking ChatGPT to exaggerate images until things got ridiculous. This time, the assignment is a little more nostalgic.

Before you post, check faces, hands and background details against your original photo. Some participants in a Reddit discussion of the trend have complained that the results don’t really look like them, so take a second look! Then comes the real decision: whether to leave that hairstyle in 1985 or bring it to your next salon appointment.
